o.text: Borrowed from Talysh lonə, ultimately Persian لانه.
From Proto-Turkic *ayt-, causative of *āy- (“to say”). Cognate with Crimean Tatar aytmaq, Tatar әйтү (äytü), Turkish ayıtmak.
